If by “unusual” you mean ads that feel more like entertaining internet content than conventional commercials, Toronto has some particularly interesting options.

My shortlist

Piston Studio — A good fit if you want high-quality, visually distinctive short-form ads. They specifically produce branded social content for TikTok, Reels and Shorts, including motion graphics and platform-specific edits.

FUSE Create — Probably the most interesting choice if you want actual creative concepts, stunts or unconventional advertising, rather than simply filming talking-head videos. They explicitly offer “stuntvertising,” UGC/influencer content and social campaigns.

Viterno Group — Strong candidate if your priority is native-to-TikTok/Reels creative that can generate serious organic reach. They report 300M+ organic views across client work and handle strategy, filming, editing and posting. 
Viterno Group

RedlineToronto — Particularly interesting for street interviews, weird questions, live activations and authentic Toronto-specific content. They handle concept → shoot → edit → distribution. 
RedlineToronto

StreetTalk — Similar street-interview approach, with real Torontonians reacting to brands/products. Their portfolio includes campaigns for Osmow's, ProPOP and Good Rebel. 
streettalk.co

Y3S Creative — More of a flexible creative-video shop, ranging from influencer-powered TikToks/Reels to full commercials. 
Y3Screative

Vaelolab — The wildcard: AI-generated short ads starting at $49 CAD/video, including unusual lifestyle, cinematic, UGC and product-showcase formats. Useful if you want to test lots of concepts cheaply before investing in shoots. 
vaelolab.com

Who I'd contact first

For genuinely weird / memorable ads, I'd start with:

1. FUSE Create → big creative ideas/stunts
2. RedlineToronto or StreetTalk → unpredictable real-person content
3. Viterno Group → performance-oriented viral short-form
4. Piston Studio → more polished/art-directed weirdness

If you tell me what your Toronto business sells + roughly what you want to spend per month, I can narrow this to 3 agencies/creators and show you the kind of unusual ad concepts I'd ask each one to pitch.
